notes.text: Story 4's third criterion rejects a reviewer blocker whose criterion is not one of the plan's criteria. A plan-stage review of a split or a question has no N.k criteria to name, so as written it would reject every such blocker. Its child planner should say what a blocker names at that moment (for example a story's criterion), alongside your answer to question 3.
